gen-gf-bellota-gf-barlow: Bellota's s lets its ends swing far from the spine, every stroke traced with one stylus width. Barlow's neon-tube strokes and open c tips keep a long text moving smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-biz-udgothic: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine. BIZ UDGothic opens a wide channel into every bowl, while Bellota's single-width strokes leave no thin lines to vanish in glare.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic spaces its sans-serif letters lavishly. Bellota is best at bent-wire sign looks with constant thickness, while the body's clear channel into each round letter does the quiet reading work.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bpmf Huninn reads like a single-weight outline with a wide channel into every bowl, set beneath Bellota. Longer stretches of text should glide along smoothly, easy on the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: The body text reads comfortably, its curved strokes swelling only slightly beneath Bellota's stencil-cut constant weight. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std sits at a midpoint between flat and dramatic strokes, and that restraint is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cairo: Sign-like and sharp, Bellota traces every stroke at one stylus width, its s ends flung far from the spine. Cairo, a plain sans, then opens a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cambay: One stylus width, all the way through: Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine. And Cambay, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle, gives lengthy paragraphs of sans text a modern, open flow.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cantarell: Cantarell reads friendly and approachable, with c tips pulled well apart and r, n and m arches that match their stems. Bellota earns its keep big and brief, its s flung wide.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-catamaran: Distinctive Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, humming along at a flat constant line weight. Catamaran then adds curvy letters that feel unclamped, a sans-serif loosening of the page.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Chiron Hei HK gives its c a bracelet-like gap, pulled apart and modern in feel. And Bellota excels at an engraver's single-depth cut, while the sans body handles the reading.
